title: A Simplified Questionnaire to Detect OSA in COPD Patients
brief_summary: To detect the existence of severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) patients, which had higher mortality and hospitalization rate, a simplified questionnaire was developed for identifying those COPD patients with severe OSA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* stable COPD patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* cancer exacerbation in recent 2 months pregnancy central type sleep apnea claustrophobia chronic respiratory failure
study_population: develop group : previous COPD cohort study validation group : consecutive COPD patient from outpatients clinics
